user.title: Add a Cartrack account
user.description: Use your Fleet API credentials from Fleetweb (Settings → API Settings). A read-only subuser API password is recommended. Add each Cartrack account as a separate entry.

data_description.username: The main account username shown in Fleetweb API Settings.
data_description.password: An administrator or subuser API password.
data_description.region: The country your Cartrack account is registered in.
data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant, e.g. Personal or Business.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter Cartrack API password
reauth_confirm.description: Cartrack rejected the password for {username}. Generate a new API password in Fleetweb and enter it here.

error.invalid_auth: Cartrack rejected the credentials. Check the username, the API password and the region.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cartrack Fleet API for this region.
error.rate_limited: Cartrack is rate limiting this account. Wait a minute and try again.
error.no_vehicles: The account has no vehicles visible to these credentials.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Cartrack account is already added.

init.title: Polling
init.description: Cartrack allows about 60 requests per minute per account.

data.scan_interval_parked: Interval while all vehicles are parked
data.scan_interval_moving: Interval while any vehicle is moving
data.stale_timeout: Treat a vehicle as parked after no updates for

data_description.stale_timeout: Stops fast polling when a vehicle loses signal while driving, for example in underground parking.
